title: Guided review: README onboarding win + build-cache config
summary: Fictional PR #2148: shorten the setup checklist in README.md and adopt a prewarmed build cache in .gitlab-ci.yml. The diff is small; the reading order below makes the pairing between docs and CI config visible. Nothing here critiques the change — each chapter just orients the reviewer to what to look at and in what order.

chapters.title: Onboarding copy (start here)
chapters.summary: This chapter is the reason the PR exists. Read README.md with a fresh-contributor eye: what does the exploded checklist claim, and does the shorter version preserve the two commands that actually matter? No judgment — just look for what a new reader will experience.

files.why: The setup section rewritten to a three-step quickstart; the upstream checklist now lives behind a 'detailed setup' link.

chapters.title: Build cache wiring
chapters.summary: The second chapter shows the mechanical support for the docs promise. The config change only makes sense if CI actually caches the same key the local script reads; verify the cache key matches across both files before scrolling on.

files.why: Adds a prewarmed build-cache job keyed on CACHE_KEY; the variable is only meaningful when checkout-local CLI reads the same key.
Local half of the cache contract: extracts the value of CACHE_KEY from the CI variables file, so a contributor can reproduce the cache locally.
